summary_1line: Bhishma recounts King Uparichara Vasu’s sacrifice, Vrihaspati’s anger when Narayana takes his offering invisibly, and sages explaining that only the graced can behold the deity.

image_candidates.scene_text: During the sacrifice, the unseen Narayana accepts the offering while Vrihaspati angrily hurls the ladle toward the sky.
King Uparichara performs a grand horse-sacrifice surrounded by sixteen revered sages acting as priests and witnesses.
Ekata, Dwita, and Trita stand on one foot in severe penance on the northern shores near the Ocean of Milk beneath the distant Mount Meru.
